steps.s: Business units or whole businesses, feeding the dashboard

guide.text: Create your first business unit. A unit is a team, a site, or a whole business; everything inside it rolls up to the dashboard.
subs: Name it and give it a responsibility
Create it, then invite users and register assets

guide.text: Create a repository for your policies, then upload. Set the purpose, owners and review date; switch on authorisation where sign-off is needed.
subs: Upload your files with purpose and applicable modules
Confirm owners, review dates and authorisation

steps.s: Compliance Settings; evidence on the clause; the link follows every version

guide.text: Open a document and tie it to the clauses it supports. It becomes evidence on those controls and the link follows every new version.
subs: Select the standards and clauses it supports

steps.s: Built from your toolkits; select, status, evidence; the score moves

guide.text: iMS OS has built the Statement of Applicability from your licensed toolkits. Confirm what applies, set the status, attach the evidence; the score moves as you go.

steps.s: Raise and score; Alice gives impacts, mitigations, controls

guide.text: Raise a risk against the organisation or an asset, score it, then let Alice analyse it.
subs: Save Alice's response as the treatment

steps.s: Interval, compliance body, Alice's audit plan

guide.text: Schedule the audit programme once. The interval creates the series; Alice drafts the plan.
subs: Title, focus area, business unit, compliance body
Click Assist & Verification for the plan

guide.text: Schedule the management review series with attendees. Agenda, minutes and actions attach to each meeting.

steps.s: Invite your lead auditor: read-only login, live evidence, no exports

guide.text: Make the organisation remote-audit ready: your certification body becomes an external compliance function and your lead auditor gets a read-only login.
subs: Organisation › Functional Units › Create a function
Name the certification body and standards

steps.s: Policies due, controls without evidence, audits coming up; she finds, drafts and chases, you decide

guide.text: Ask Alice your first question. From now on she reviews your data daily and tells you what needs attention.
subs: Open one of the records she links
